statement.zh:
**算法**：门限签名（Threshold Signature）。### Shamir 分享与 Lagrange

门限签名把群私钥 s 用 Shamir 分享分成 n 份，任意 t 份用 Lagrange 系数重组；FROST 两轮：先发布 nonce 承诺，再聚合成 z=Σz_i 的普通 Schnorr 签名。### FROST 两轮

FROST 第一轮每个签名者生成一次性 nonce (d,e) 并发布承诺 (D,E)；第二轮用消息、承诺集合和自身 share 计算 z_i；协调者聚合 z=Σz_i。签名可像单签者 Schnorr 一样验证。### DKG

密钥生成可用可信 dealer，也可用分布式密钥生成；DKG 让各方在没有完整 s 的情况下生成 share，但协议更复杂。
statement.en:
**Algorithm**: Threshold Signature (门限签名).### Shamir sharing and Lagrange

Threshold signing Shamir-shares the group secret s into n shares, and any t shares reconstruct it via Lagrange coefficients; FROST uses two rounds—publish nonce commitments, then aggregate z=Σz_i into an ordinary Schnorr signature.

statement.zh: 门限签名把单点私钥变成 t-of-n：少于 t 个 share 泄露不泄露 s，至少 t 个诚实方在线才能签；适合交易所冷钱包、CA 根密钥、企业签名和区块链验证者。FROST 只需两轮，且不限制并发签名会话；签名与普通 Schnorr 不可区分，链上或协议上不暴露门限结构。
statement.en: Threshold signatures turn a single private key into t-of-n: fewer than t shares do not reveal s, and at least t honest parties must be online to sign.They suit exchange cold wallets, CA root keys, enterprise signing and blockchain validators.

statement.zh: 用于区块链托管和验证者、CA 与代码签名、企业多签、DNSSEC 和跨机构审批；RFC 9591 定义 FROST 及 Ed25519/Ed448 兼容套件，密钥生成可用可信 dealer 或 DKG。工程要点：nonce 绝不能重用；每个签名会话要绑定唯一消息和承诺集合；协调者要验证部分签名；DKG 要防恶意 share 和抱怨；门限签名不是多签，链上只看到一个公钥。
statement.en: It is used for blockchain custody and validators, CA and code signing, enterprise multisignature, DNSSEC and cross-institution approvals; RFC 9591 defines FROST and Ed25519/Ed448-compatible suites, with trusted-dealer or DKG key generation.Requirements: never reuse a nonce; bind every signing session to a unique message and commitment set; the coordinator must verify partial signatures; DKG must handle malicious shares and complaints; a threshold signature is not multisig—only one public key appears on-chain.

statement.zh: 最致命的实现错误是 nonce 重用：两个签名共享同一个 (d,e) 会直接解出 share，进而恢复群私钥；RFC 9591 要求 nonce 一次性并建议签名后擦除。
statement.en: The most damaging implementation error is nonce reuse: two signatures sharing the same (d,e) directly solve for a share and then the group private key; RFC 9591 requires one-time nonces and recommends erasing them after signing.Boundaries: threshold signing protects the private key, not endpoints; a malicious coordinator can deny service or choose messages but cannot forge; t or more colluding parties can recover s; FROST is not post-quantum and relies on discrete logarithms.

statement.zh:
FROST 由 Komlo 与 Goldberg 在 2020 年论文中提出（ePrint 2020/852），2021 年进入 CFRG，2024 年 6 月发布 RFC 9591；它基于 Schnorr 门限签名和 Shamir 分享，改进早期方案的三轮和并发限制。RFC 9591 是 Informational，不是 IETF 标准；生产部署要按具体曲线和协议做域分离。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(s=k^{-1}\big(H(m)+r d\big)\bmod n\)。输入：输入：门限签名的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：k 一次性随机数，r 为承诺点横坐标，d 私钥，n 子群阶。
statement.en: FROST was proposed by Komlo and Goldberg in 2020 (ePrint 2020/852), entered CFRG in 2021 and became RFC 9591 in June 2024.It builds on Schnorr threshold signatures and Shamir sharing, improving earlier three-round and concurrency-limited schemes.
